subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should this PR wait for a redacted live TTS or Gateway run proving file-source persona SecretRef resolution, or may it merge on targeted tests and bundle inspection only?
rationale: The patch touches credential routing for provider API keys, and the contributor-provided proof currently shows tests/static bundle output rather than the real runtime path reported by the linked issue.

options.title: Require live SecretRef TTS proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal or log output from openclaw infer tts convert or an equivalent Gateway TTS call using a file-source persona SecretRef before merge.

options.title: Accept targeted tests only
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge on collector, registry, and command-target coverage alone, accepting unproven live runtime credential behavior for this external PR.

recommendation.title: Require live SecretRef TTS proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal or log output from openclaw infer tts convert or an equivalent Gateway TTS call using a file-source persona SecretRef before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant authored the broad SecretRef framework this PR extends and is the best available owner for proof-sufficiency and target-scope judgment.
